novelty_note: Original OREZ combinations and game concepts; not a claim that no other product has related ideas.
scope: 45 proposals. Stabilize boot, installation, updates and recovery first. Games are optional native downloads, not mandatory preload.

ideas.title: Ink Courier
ideas.description: Deliver letters through brush-painted villages by drawing a limited supply of ink platforms.
ideas.engineering: Small native Godot 2D game; keyboard/controller; offline.
ideas.acceptance: Finish ten levels with remappable controls and a 60-FPS target on qualified hardware.

ideas.title: Folded Worlds
ideas.description: Fold a paper map to connect paths, redirect light and reach hidden rooms.
ideas.engineering: Native puzzle game with deterministic undo; no ads or purchases.
ideas.acceptance: Every puzzle has a reachable solution and undo restores the exact board.

ideas.title: Quiet Station
ideas.description: Repair a train station by arranging signals, power and passenger routes.
ideas.engineering: Short pause-anytime logic sessions; optional local co-op later.
ideas.acceptance: Pause/save/reload preserves the complete simulation without losing progress.

ideas.title: Shadow Garden
ideas.description: Grow a moonlit garden by placing trees whose shadows form changing paths.
ideas.engineering: Low-spec turn-based puzzle with an accessible high-contrast mode.
ideas.acceptance: All puzzles remain playable without colour discrimination or timed input.

ideas.title: Rewind Harbour
ideas.description: Route small boats through a harbour while rewinding selected objects instead of the entire world.
ideas.engineering: A compact native puzzle prototype; bounded simulation history.
ideas.acceptance: Rewind cannot duplicate rewards or corrupt saved games.

ideas.title: Project Rooms
ideas.description: Open a chosen set of files, apps and window positions as one named work context.
ideas.engineering: Local workspace manifests; never store credentials or automatically execute imported scripts.
ideas.acceptance: Export/import a room; missing apps are explained and no command runs without permission.

ideas.title: Change Receipts
ideas.description: Show what every OREZ-managed update or settings action changed, why, and how to undo it.
ideas.engineering: Start with OREZ operations; never claim to capture every arbitrary root command.
ideas.acceptance: Apply and undo a supported change; compare effective state and preserve the audit entry.

ideas.title: Resource Agreements
ideas.description: Give a foreground game, render or call a visible resource budget and postpone optional background jobs.
ideas.engineering: Use supported Linux cgroups/PSI; owner can override; no magical CPU/GPU unlock.
ideas.acceptance: Measure frame times and responsiveness under enforced competing loads.

ideas.title: Offline Readiness
ideas.description: A clear checklist shows which apps, drivers, documentation and recovery tools really work without internet.
ideas.engineering: Package/content inventory plus explicit offline tests.
ideas.acceptance: Disconnect networking and launch every item marked ready; stale claims must disappear.

ideas.title: Context Dock
ideas.description: Each Project Room can keep a small set of relevant files and safe actions in its own dock.
ideas.engineering: Explicit local configuration; no covert usage tracking.
ideas.acceptance: Switch rooms repeatedly without launching hidden apps or leaking another room’s recent files.

ideas.title: Access Receipts
ideas.description: Display the app, exact folder/device, purpose, duration and revocation control for permission grants.
ideas.engineering: Narrow capability broker; OS authentication is separate from AI text.
ideas.acceptance: Wrong app, expired token and revoked token must all be rejected.

ideas.title: Canary Documents
ideas.description: Optional decoy documents detect suspicious mass rewriting near protected work.
ideas.engineering: Evidence-based alert first; ignore known backup/indexing workflows; no automatic destructive response.
ideas.acceptance: Run benign indexers and controlled synthetic ransomware fixtures; measure both misses and false alarms.

ideas.title: Remote-Control Beacon
ideas.description: Show a persistent, owner-controlled indicator whenever an authorized remote-input session exists.
ideas.engineering: Track known remote sessions and device arrivals, not private keystrokes; cannot prove human identity.
ideas.acceptance: Start/revoke a permitted session; injected USB input must not be mislabeled as proven owner activity.

ideas.title: Payment Workspace
ideas.description: Offer a separate, minimal browser profile for financial work with reduced extensions and sharing.
ideas.engineering: Opt-in isolation, clear domain display and ordinary bank authentication; no guarantee against phishing.
ideas.acceptance: Verify profile/cookie separation, clipboard policy and permission revocation with dummy accounts.

ideas.title: Revocation-Safe Restore
ideas.description: Restore the system without silently resurrecting revoked devices, tokens or obsolete trust decisions.
ideas.engineering: Separate revocation records from ordinary rollback; require owner-held recovery credentials.
ideas.acceptance: Revoke access, roll back, and prove the revoked principal still cannot connect.

ideas.title: Hold-to-Learn
ideas.description: Hold a configurable key to see the shortcuts available in the current app.
ideas.engineering: Accessible overlay; query known app bindings; do not intercept passwords.
ideas.acceptance: Overlay is readable at 200% scale and never consumes a typing shortcut unintentionally.

ideas.title: Action Palette
ideas.description: Search settings, apps and safe operations with clear previews and required permissions.
ideas.engineering: Local command registry; no arbitrary shell execution from guessed natural language.
ideas.acceptance: Ambiguous and privileged actions require explicit selection and normal authentication.

ideas.title: Return to Task
ideas.description: One configurable action returns to the previous Project Room and focused document.
ideas.engineering: Window/app context only; recovery of unsaved documents depends on application support.
ideas.acceptance: Switch across three rooms; restore the correct window without exposing hidden work.

ideas.title: Peek and Place
ideas.description: Hold a shortcut, choose a workspace visually, and release to move the current window.
ideas.engineering: Use compositor APIs and cancel safely with Escape.
ideas.acceptance: Move/cancel repeatedly across multiple displays without losing the window.

ideas.title: Private Paste Shelf
ideas.description: An opt-in temporary shelf holds selected clipboard items and clears them visibly.
ideas.engineering: Never assume sensitive-content detection is perfect; exclude password managers where supported.
ideas.acceptance: Disable/clear removes stored items; clipboard synchronization remains separately consented.

ideas.title: Task Lanes
ideas.description: Group windows by activity and give each group its own notification policy.
ideas.engineering: Reuse Plasma workspaces/activities with a coherent OREZ interface.
ideas.acceptance: Switch groups under load and prove notification exceptions still work.

ideas.title: Window Placeholders
ideas.description: After restart, show where previous windows belonged and let the owner reopen them.
ideas.engineering: Do not claim to recover arbitrary app memory or unsaved content.
ideas.acceptance: Unavailable files/apps produce useful placeholders and never trigger silent downloads.

ideas.title: Drop-to-Action Tray
ideas.description: Drop selected files onto explicit local actions such as convert, compress or compare.
ideas.engineering: Preview output and destination; preserve originals; external sending is always separate.
ideas.acceptance: Cancellation leaves originals intact; path traversal and command injection are refused.

ideas.title: Phone Handoff Parcel
ideas.description: Send a selected document or task note to the paired phone with a visible transfer receipt.
ideas.engineering: Build on KDE Connect; selected data only, encrypted transport where supported.
ideas.acceptance: Pair, send, interrupt, retry and revoke against an actual Android device.

ideas.title: Attention Queue
ideas.description: Collect routine notifications while recording or gaming, then present a concise review.
ideas.engineering: User-defined exceptions for calls and critical warnings; no invisible permanent suppression.
ideas.acceptance: A critical alert remains visible and queued notifications survive an app restart.

ideas.title: Graphics Safe Profile
ideas.description: Keep a tested conservative display/effects profile for recovery after graphics problems.
ideas.engineering: Supported driver/compositor options only; no firmware or voltage bypass.
ideas.acceptance: Recover from a deliberately bad test profile on a VM and the actual GPU.

ideas.title: Checkpoint Before Change
ideas.description: Create an appropriate system checkpoint before supported driver or OS changes.
ideas.engineering: Snapshots complement independent backups; account for app consistency and revocations.
ideas.acceptance: Interrupt an update, restore, and verify both boot and untouched user documents.

ideas.title: Restart Only What Failed
ideas.description: Offer to restart a hung app or desktop shell while keeping other applications running.
ideas.engineering: Record diagnostics with consent; never promise recovery of all unsaved app state.
ideas.acceptance: Crash the selected component and prove unrelated processes/data remain intact.

ideas.title: Trial Boot Updates
ideas.description: Boot a staged update once and retain a known-good recovery choice until health checks pass.
ideas.engineering: Design against rollback to vulnerable versions and protect trust/revocation state.
ideas.acceptance: Failed boot returns to the approved recovery path without deleting user files.

ideas.title: Memory Pressure Assistant
ideas.description: Explain memory pressure and offer to pause selected background work before a severe stall.
ideas.engineering: Use actual pressure metrics and bounded zram/swap policies; no cache-clearing gimmicks.
ideas.acceptance: Test enforced 6/16-GiB workloads, missed warnings and false interventions.

ideas.title: Thermal Context
ideas.description: Explain sustained temperature, fan and throttling patterns in plain language.
ideas.engineering: Read hwmon/NVML when available; offer maintenance advice rather than unsafe tuning.
ideas.acceptance: Compare displayed values with trusted tools and handle missing sensors honestly.

ideas.title: Storage Care
ideas.description: Track NVMe health, free-space pressure and supported maintenance schedules.
ideas.engineering: No automatic formatting, destructive tests or unsupported repair operations.
ideas.acceptance: Recognize simulated warning logs; verify read-only polling and safe cancellation.

ideas.title: Power With Evidence
ideas.description: Compare quiet, balanced and performance profiles using measured workload results.
ideas.engineering: Owner chooses the trade-off; avoid universal better-performance/lower-power promises.
ideas.acceptance: Repeat the same benchmark and record power, temperature and completion time.

ideas.title: Backup Rehearsal
ideas.description: Periodically restore a chosen sample into an isolated folder to check backup usability.
ideas.engineering: Explicit opt-in, encrypted backups where configured, and no original-file overwrite.
ideas.acceptance: Detect a damaged backup and recover the sample with an owner-held key.

ideas.title: Restful Desktop
ideas.description: Schedule quiet periods and sleep around the owner’s actual work rather than a fixed idle timer alone.
ideas.engineering: Respect renders, recordings and active sessions; explain every inhibited sleep request.
ideas.acceptance: Verify sleep/wake and display reconnection while preserving active work.

ideas.title: Readable Paper Glass
ideas.description: Use restrained translucent panels with an opaque fallback when contrast or GPU resources require it.
ideas.engineering: Accessible colours, cached effects and a visible effects switch.
ideas.acceptance: Check contrast on both supplied wallpapers and under software rendering.

ideas.title: Meaningful Motion
ideas.description: Animate where a window or task went, using short transitions that can be disabled.
ideas.engineering: Respect reduced-motion preferences everywhere.
ideas.acceptance: No task requires animation to understand its state; measure input latency.

ideas.title: Truthful Status
ideas.description: Show effective configuration and distinguish ready, unavailable, pending and failed features.
ideas.engineering: No fake connected devices, working AI badges or implied successful installs.
ideas.acceptance: Disconnect services/devices and compare the UI with actual backend state.

ideas.title: One Search, Clear Scope
ideas.description: Search apps and settings together, with optional file indexing under explicit exclusions.
ideas.engineering: Local-first indexing; expose included locations and deletion controls.
ideas.acceptance: Excluded/private locations never appear and changed settings are discoverable.

ideas.title: Keyboard and Pointer Equality
ideas.description: Make every important action usable with visible focus, mouse, keyboard and assistive tools.
ideas.engineering: Avoid tiny controls, hidden hover-only actions and icon-only consent.
ideas.acceptance: Complete the main journeys without a mouse and at enlarged text scale.

ideas.title: Silver Mist
ideas.description: Cool grayscale paper, light glass and subtle silver focus outlines.
ideas.engineering: Keep the approved tree imagery and minimal palette.
ideas.acceptance: Contrast and focus indicators pass on light and detailed wallpaper regions.

ideas.title: Moonlit Ink
ideas.description: Charcoal surfaces with pale brush details and quiet, warm-white text.
ideas.engineering: A proposed refinement beyond the current basic OREZ Ink palette.
ideas.acceptance: Unchecked controls, disabled states and text remain distinguishable.

ideas.title: Snow Field
ideas.description: Nearly white surfaces, generous spacing and a small ink-red accent.
ideas.engineering: Red is optional and never the sole meaning of a status.
ideas.acceptance: All status meanings remain clear in grayscale and colour-vision simulations.

ideas.title: Archive Paper
ideas.description: Warm handmade-paper tones with compact typography for long reading and coding.
ideas.engineering: Font choice and density remain user-controlled.
ideas.acceptance: Review long documents, code and file lists at common display scales.

ideas.title: Focus Contrast
ideas.description: Opaque black/white surfaces, strong borders and reduced animation.
ideas.engineering: Accessibility/performance profile with the same features as decorative themes.
ideas.acceptance: Every permission, error and focus state remains visible with effects disabled.
